projects.name: Manyar smelter
projects.quote: Smelter construction was approximately 60% complete at March 31, 2023, and is expected to be commissioned during 2024 at an estimated cost of $3.0 billion, including $2.8 billion for a construction contract (excluding capitalized interest, owner’s costs and commissioning) and $0.2 billion for investment in a desalinization plant.

projects.name: PT Smelting Expansion
projects.quote: PT-FI is funding the cost of the expansion, estimated to approximate $250 million, with a loan that will convert to equity and increase PT-FI’s ownership in PT Smelting to a majority ownership interest upon project completion.

projects.name: Precious Metals Refinery (PMR)
projects.quote: Construction of a precious metals refinery (PMR) to process gold and silver from the Manyar smelter and PT Smelting at an estimated cost of $400 million.

projects.name: Grasberg Mill Recovery Project
projects.quote: Grasberg Mill Recovery Project ● Installing new copper cleaner circuit ● Improved Cu concentrate grades/metal recoveries ● Capital investment: ~$470 mm (~$230 mm in 2023e) ● Targeted completion: 1H24e

projects.name: Lone Star Oxide Expansion
projects.quote: Lone Star Oxide Expansion ● Low capital intensity investment ● Capital investment: ~$300 mm (~$120 mm in 2023e)

projects.name: Atlantic Copper CirCular
projects.quote: Capital investment: ~$330 mm (~$140 mm in 2023e) ● Expect to commission in 2024e; full rates in 2025e

projects.name: Kucing Liar
projects.quote: Capital investment: ~$400 mm/yr average (~$415 mm in 2023e) ● 6.8 bn lbs copper & 6.5 mm ozs gold o ~ 550 mm lbs & 560K ozs per annum Kucing Liar

projects.name: Bagdad 2X Expansion
projects.quote: Planning expansion to double concentrator capacity ● Conducting feasibility study; expected completion 2H23 ● Early works: ~$285 mm (~$190 mm in 2023e) Bagdad 2X Expansion
